newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: McCarthy to list in Botswana, Namibia.
newsitem.headline: McCarthy to list in Botswana, Namibia.

text.p: South African holding firm McCarthy Retail Ltd said on Thursday it planned to list on the Namibian and Botswana stock exchanges in March and April respectively.
McCarthy posted an annual turnover to the year ended June, 1996, of 9.3 billion rand. The firm focuses on retailing cars, furniture, household goods, clothing and building materials.
The firm will list 160.05 million shares of no par value on the exchanges. The Namibian listing will take place on March 19 and the Botswana listing by April 8.
On Wednesday, diamond giant De Beers Ltd said it planned to list its De Beers/Centenary linked units on the stock exchanges of Botswana and Namibia.
The listing of such large South African firms on the tiny exchanges should greatly boost their market capitalisation and liquidity.
On Thursday, Botswana bourse chief executive Alan Norrie said the De Beers listing should increase the market capitalisation of the bourse at least 50-fold.
The current market capitalisation of the exchange is 1,200 million pula and, once listed, De Beers will account for 97 percent of the aggregate total of the exchange.
